verdict.rationale: Airwallex offers card authorization controls that can restrict how/where cards are used and cashback/spend control marketing for corporate cards, which supports enforceable spend limits at the card level, but there is no explicit documentation of department- or program-level budget hierarchies with automatic enforcement tied to organizational structure. Missing for 10: documented budget/program-level allocation feature, hierarchical department budget setting, evidence of automatic alerts/blocks tied to budget vs simple per-card authorization rules.
